title: Sol de Janeiro teams up with Brazilian racing driver Aurelia Nobels
summary: Sol de Janeiro has partnered with rising Brazilian racing driver Aurelia Nobels to launch Aurelia Perfume Mist , a limited-edition fragrance inspired by her Brazilian roots and the adrenaline of motorsport. A rising talent in motorsport, Nobels began racing at the age of 10 in Brazil. In 2022, she became the first woman to compete in the Brazilian F4 Championship and won the Senior category of the FIA Girls on Track – Rising Stars program.
